info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Inventory Item Retrieval API
info.description: The Product Inventory Item Retrieval API serves as a vital tool for accessing detailed information about specific product inventory items within a banking context. This endpoint allows authorized users to query the inventory by providing a unique identifier. Typical consumers include inventory managers and banking officials who need to track product availability and specifications. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their inventory management, ensure accurate data reporting, and optimize product offerings based on current stock levels.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific product inventory item.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about a specific product inventory item identified by its unique ID (PROD-700045). Use this to access all relevant information about the inventory item, including its status, availability, and related attributes.

requestBody.description: A JSON formatted request body for managing the product inventory item defined by the specific product ID PROD-700045. This request is used to retrieve inventory details and associated data.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning product inventory details.

GetProductInventoryItemByIdRequest.description: This schema represents a string type used for the request body in the specific product inventory item management API call.

GetProductInventoryItemByIdResponse_200.title: Product Inventory Item Management Response

inventoryItemId.description: The unique identifier for the inventory item.

sku.description: The stock keeping unit identifier for the product.

branchId.description: The unique identifier for the branch associated with the inventory item.

quantityOnHand.description: The current quantity of the inventory item available in stock.

reorderPoint.description: The predefined point at which inventory should be reordered.

distributionQuantity.description: The quantity allocated for distribution to branches.

recordStatus.description: The status of the inventory record (e.g., active, inactive).

version.description: The version number of the inventory item record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the inventory item record was last updated.

GetProductInventoryItemByIdResponse_200.description: Represents the response structure for fetching product inventory items.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method. It requires a token to be sent in the Authorization header, formatted as a JSON Web Token (JWT). Clients must provide a valid JWT to authenticate their requests.
